Lead qualification

Know what the customer needs before you follow up.

Scope and fit

We ask about the space, access, approximate area, existing insulation and any reported moisture concerns.

Location and timing

We check the customer’s service area and timing against the ZIP codes and availability you share.

Customer contact

We verify contact details and confirm the inquiry before matching it with a single business.

Local search

Build visibility for searches like “attic insulation near me” and “crawl space insulation in [your city].”

Questions about the program

Can I narrow which jobs I take?

Yes. Share the jobs you handle, the ZIP codes you cover and any work you don’t take when you sign up.

How do leads reach me?

Choose verified lead details, scheduled calls or appointment booking on the order form. Shedlr delivers each verified lead to one business.

Does the plan guarantee a number of jobs?

No. Local demand, service area and your criteria affect availability, and a lead is not a booked job or a guaranteed sale.
